title: Personal VM Guest Heartbeat
description: Guest-specific mTLS certificate required. Core checks pinned credential, current owner/access, unrevoked binding, validity, identity revision, compute generation and strictly increasing sequence atomically. Observation must fall within binding validity and 30 seconds of server time. Heartbeat is liveness only: provider, data mount/UUID/hard quota, command/file/browser probes remain independent; this message has no readiness or arbitrary capabilities field. POST /api/personal-guest/v1/bindings/{bindingId}/heartbeats returns 204 only after atomic monotonic sequence storage, current authority and pinned mTLS checks. Replayed/stale sequence or mismatched binding/generation: 409; rejected current authority: 403; wrong/expired certificate registration: 401. Body is bounded to 4096 UTF-8 bytes; duplicate keys and noncanonical field casing are rejected. Heartbeat never sets environment/data/tool readiness.
